scope: Infrastructure qualification before the official 100M-frame public reproduction; no capability claim

qualification_run.only_nonofficial_change: deterministic actor seed routing for reproducibility
procedure: run the official multi/stateful=false contract for two learner updates
preserve the complete official job.tar without deleting the experiment directory
verify model_state_dict, optimizer_state_dict, scheduler_state_dict and frame counter
clone the complete experiment directory twice
resume both clones for one identical additional learner update
require equal model, optimizer and scheduler tensor digests and advanced frame counters

required_artifacts: initial and both resumed official job.tar checkpoints
model, optimizer and scheduler tensor digests
exact commands and deterministic source patch hashes
peak RSS and wall time for initial and resumed runs
host provenance, raw install/training logs and pip freeze
failure_policy: If the official checkpoint or resume path fails, preserve the exact stage, command, logs and partial checkpoint bundle, then repair only that infrastructure defect. Do not substitute a reduced training contract and call it public reproduction.
next_gate: Only after checkpoint/resume qualification succeeds may the canonical branch schedule the 100M-frame, three-seed official baseline and matched random/language-blind/state-only controls.
